# Canon: Pre-Publication Brand Governance Platform
> Deterministic, double-receipt brand compliance and policy governance platform for enterprise marketing collateral.

## Overview
Canon decouples compliance verification from generative AI. It replaces probabilistic screening with an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) tokenization compiler, verified claims ledger, and cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 release certificates.

## Core Architectural Invariants
- **Double-Receipt Invariant:**
  - Receipt A: Character-exact slice `[start_offset, end_offset]` in user draft.
  - Receipt B: Exact citation and verbatim quotation from the active brand policy charter.
- **Zero Probabilistic Drift:** Compliance checking executes in <4ms via deterministic regex and AST lexing, eliminating LLM hallucinations.
- **Multi-Provider AI Waterfall:** Groq (Qwen-3.8-27B) -> Google Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Flash) -> Deterministic Algorithmic NLP Engine.
- **Cryptographic Release Verification:** HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated across `certificate_id`, `submission_id`, `content_sha256`, and sign-off timestamp.

## Canonical Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/health/live`: Gateway live probe
- `GET /api/v1/auth/me`: Active session telemetry (auto-hydrated role)
- `POST /api/v1/submissions`: Create draft campaign
- `POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/check`: Execute real-time AST compliance verification
- `GET /api/v1/submissions/{id}/certificate`: Generate cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 release certificate
- `POST /api/v1/copilot/rewrite`: Universal multi-provider AI compliance rewrite
- `POST /api/v1/copilot/extract-guidelines`: Synthesize structured AST rules from unstructured text
- `GET /api/v1/copilot/showdown`: Head-to-head adversarial benchmark (LLM vs Canon)
- `GET /api/v1/governance/policy/active`: Active compiled rules and claims ledger
- `GET /api/v1/governance/health`: Continuous rule drift analytics
- `POST /api/v1/governance/proposals/{id}/backtest`: Historical corpus simulation
- `GET /api/v1/governance/benchmark`: Live 30-case benchmark suite (Precision, Recall, F1)
- `GET /api/v1/review/queue`: Reviewer queue with pushdown filters
- `GET /api/v1/transparency/disclosure`: EU AI Act Art. 50/52 audit disclosures

## Core Pages
- `/`: Platform overview, live gateway health badge, and architecture
- `/submissions`: Interactive Creator Studio with live highlighting and AI copilot rewrite
- `/review`: Compliance review queue with mandatory reason-code overrides and formal sign-off
- `/policy`: Active rules catalog, statutory quotes, and guideline ingester
- `/governance`: Proposal backtesting and rule health metrics
- `/evaluation`: Real-time 30-case benchmark harness and Adversarial Showdown
- `/transparency`: EU AI Act Article 50 & 52 transparency ledger
- `/demo`: Guided evaluator tour
- `/about`: Platform mission and technical architecture
- `/contact`: Direct communication & vulnerability reporting
- `/privacy`: Enterprise data protection and zero-retention guarantee
- `/terms`: Enterprise SaaS terms and disclaimer of legal warranty
- `/cookies`: Strictly essential cookies disclosure
